broccoli:

Just got both Golem Unity and Engine of War Bunker in the same game.  Team was:Argent Adept, (normal) Bunker, Omnitron-X, Unity vs. Baron Blade in the BlockBased on some stuff from the Steam forums, I thought that Bunker dying in the Block (where Fright Train is seen) was a good idea.  I thought that Prison Riot might be a necessary component, but I never saw it, so I guess it isn't. I basically used AA and O-X to give Unity tons of card plays while Bunker used Grenade Launcher on various targets and stacked up the Omni-Cannon.  Once Unity had a fleet of bots, I had Bunker Omni-Cannon himself and then I let Unity's bots start hitting herself to get her down to 6.  Raptor bot won the game with a hit for 12 against the Baron.  I started using O-X on The Block to try for Prison Riot, but never saw it (or apparently needed it).Prior to this game (based on advice from both forums) I lost 2 games against Iron Legacy using various Freedom Six team comps.

 

Unlocked both myself using a very similar method.  Lost to Iron Legacy (not advanced) with (in order) Tachyon, Bunker, Unity, Omnitron, Argent in the Block.  Took all of two turns lol.  After that, went straight into a standard Blade in the Block.  Had Bunker in front, followed in order by Unity, Omni and AA.  No Tachyon for this fight.  Put 12 golems in play by the end, including all of the Five, with a raptor getting the last shot in on an empty field (no other targets except heroes and Blade).  Unity was at 9HP, Bunker was incap'd, AA and Omni were at 20+. 

 

Notes:

Blade had 15 cards in the trash at the end of his last turn before flipping.

The environment did cycle itself once. 

No Omni-Cannon.  the only cards Bunker played were Flak Cannon, Grenade Launcher, Foam Grenade, his retrieve-equip-from-trash card and Aux Power Source, which were used for Unity's bots and a single instance of flak+grenade.  Didn't play a single mode card.  That might be the key.

For Unity, all of the Five bots did use their special abilities at least once.  All damage dealing bots did at least one instance of damage, some against Bunker.

I don't think Omni-Cannon is required, as at least one person above reported unlocking the variant without it. And I've done the remaining conditions without getting the unlock.

 

EDIT: Okay, I just unlocked the variant and I'm pretty sure I've figured out the condition. In addition to getting incapped during the battle, Bunker has to discard a certain number of mode cards, or maybe have them in his trash at the end of the game. This ties in with Engine of War's power, which involves discarding mode cards.

I think this is why people are having success with Omni-Cannon even though it's not strictly required: it's one of the easiest ways to discard Bunker's cards, and since there was a theory that you couldn't play any mode cards (not sure if that part is true or not) most people were probably using mode cards as cannon fuel.

I had six mode cards in my trash at the end of the game, so here's my guess for the unlock condition:

Lose a game to Iron Legacy with regular Bunker on the team. Then, defeat any villain with regular Bunker and without a Legacy on the team. At least (3? 4? 5?) mode cards must be discarded, and Bunker must be incapacitated at the end of the battle.

I'm not positive about the number of mode cards, and there may be other conditions too (like playing Flak Cannon/Grenade Launcher, or not playing certain cards) but the other F6 unlocks have been pretty straightforward so I feel like this is pretty close.
